methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and managed-services leader across five industry groups with $80.62B bookings in FY25; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not; re-filed under GenAI: the stock trades at 17.9x FY26E — a discount to its own history (1th percentile of its 10-yr range), while its own 10-K FY24 says some services and tasks 'will be replaced by automation, including AI-enabled solutions, which will lead to reduced demand for our services'. Back to DURABLE when the multiple is above the 30th percentile and managed services grow 3% LC or more

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2024 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital-, cloud- and security-related offerings, which are continually evolving, as well as developments in areas such as AI, including generative AI, augmented and virtual reality, automation, blockchain, Internet of Things, quantum and edge computing, infrastructure and network engineering, intelligent connected products, digital ... engineering and manufacturing, and robotics solutions. ... Some of these technological developments have reduced and replaced, in whole or in part, some of our historical services and solutions and will continue to do so in the future.' At the same time it reports 'growing demand to assist clients with application modernization and maintenance, cloud enablement and cybersecurity-as-a-service'. The stock trades at 17.9x FY26E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and managed-services leader across five industry groups with $80.62B bookings in FY25; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not; re-filed under GenAI: the stock trades at 17.9x FY26E — a discount to its own history (1th percentile of its 10-yr range), while its own 10-K FY24 says some services and tasks 'will be replaced by automation, including AI-enabled solutions, which will lead to reduced demand for our services'. Back to DURABLE when the multiple is above the 30th percentile and managed services grow 3% LC or more. AI-exposed franchise (obsolescence risk 3/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.13x; -6% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.14; conservative 2yr +48%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY14-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.1%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.0%/yr (FY14-FY25 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +19.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY25); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2025-10-03) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.13x (-11.7% downside to Bear $274 / +88.7% upside to Bull $463) | Adj composite 2.55 vs market 1.41: gap +1.14 [UNDERVALUED] | -6% above the EPP floor $260 (19x FY26E $13.71) | Conservative 2-yr case: +48.0% total (+24.0%/yr) | At 17.9x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $324 sits at or below the BASE case; consulting +3% LC in Q4, Q1 guided +1-5% LC; GenAI is a live disruption theme the stock is priced for: the stock trades at 17.9x FY26E — a discount to its own history (1th percentile of its 10-yr range).
